title: Vic Fangio: "Remains to be seen" if Jonathan Greenard practices in training camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Vic Fangio: "Remains to be seen" if Jonathan Greenard practices in training camp
sources.description: Eagles General Manager Howie Roseman said at a Wednesday press conference that the pec strain that landed linebacker Jonathan Greenard on the physically unable to perform list "is not a long-term injury," but it doesn't sound like it's going to be a matter of days before the veteran is back on the field.
